parameters.content:
# Setup notes

1. Import this JSON into n8n.
2. Connect Gmail OAuth2 credentials in all Gmail nodes.
3. Connect OpenRouter credentials in the HTTP Request node.
4. Connect Google Sheets OAuth2 credentials.
5. Create a Google Sheet named `Gmail AI Manager Log` with a tab named `Email Log`.
6. Add these columns exactly: Date, Email From, Email To, Subject, Category, Confidence, Reason, Summary, Suggested Action, Draft Created, Gmail Link, Account Source.
7. Replace the Sheet ID in the Google Sheets node.
8. Create Gmail labels manually before activation:
- AI Manager/Important
- AI Manager/Needs Review
- AI Manager/Business Leads
- AI Manager/Delete Candidate

Safety: This workflow labels delete candidates for review. Do not enable automatic delete until you test on your own inbox.
